size_reason: Turn-end refuse-hook on session captain slash or skill tokens plus a deliverable map. Widen the landed owner-invoke helper. Full adversary rounds are a later ship if the light refuse is trusted.
shape: A captain named an owner-invoke skill and this seat ended the turn without that skill's durable deliverable.
structure: bin/fm-owner-invoke-wait-check.sh R-owner-invoke-deliverable on session captain_text /token $token or captain-turn skill load, plus turn.deliverables gathered from data/tv-vision, data/**/SESSION.md mtime versus state/.lock, data/**/map.md, and claims.json paths. Does not require OWNER_INVOKE_WAIT. Does not hunt free English.
instances: Captain named vision and the turn ended with no VISION.draft.md, answers file, or repo VISION.md.
Captain named wayfinder and the turn ended with no map.md.

fixture_source.derivation: reconstruct the primary-chat owner-invoke sitting as captain slash tokens plus missing deliverable booleans, not as OWNER_INVOKE_WAIT and not as English-prose regex

ci_gate: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs bin/fm-test-run.sh --check-coverage and all portable lanes; the test inventory includes tests/fm-owner-invoke-wait-check.test.sh and tests/fm-turnend-guard.test.sh
limits: Free English skill names without / or $ are invisible.
A leftover map.md, claims.json, or SESSION.md older than this session lock does not satisfy.
An unrelated SESSION.md under data/ with this-session mtime can satisfy grill.
A pre-existing tv-vision draft or repo VISION.md can satisfy vision.
Split transcripts can hide a captain invoke.
skipped: Adversarial rounds because size is light: one fresh reader via the test suite is enough.
